errors.text_span: 该图表包含四组并排的柱状图，每组代表一种模型
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart with 5 groups, one for each test set on the x-axis. Each group contains 4 bars representing the different models. The description incorrectly states there are 4 groups, with each group representing a model.
In the "Test1" category, the bar for LSTM-HMM is clearly just above the 20% line, approximately 21%. The stated value of 22% is a slight overestimation.
In the "Test5" category, the bar for DNN-HMM reaches the 40% line. The stated value of 36% is a significant error.
In the "Test5" category, the bar for TDNN-HMM is approximately 38%. The stated value of 32% is a significant error.
In the "Test5" category, the bar for End-to-End is approximately 22%. The stated value of 14% is a significant error.

errors.text_span: 每个测试集内的四组柱状图都按模型类型分组展示。
errors.evidence: This sentence is confusing. It incorrectly uses the term "四组柱状图" (four groups of bar charts) when it should say "四个柱状图" (four bars). It also contradicts the earlier incorrect structural description.
